title: BCOBA Digital Brand Guidelines
summary: All official digital communication must remain immediately recognizable as Bandaranayake College OBA — even when a campaign has its own theme.

rules: Use the official BCOBA / school crest only from approved master files
Do not stretch, recolor, or place the crest on busy photo areas without a clear panel
Leave clear space around the crest equal to at least the height of the letter B in BCOBA

fonts.body: Manrope / clean sans for body and UI
fonts.note: Avoid decorative novelty fonts on official posts

tone: Respectful, confident, alumni-warm — never slangy or political
English and Sinhala may both be used; keep official notices clear and formal
Credit people and photo sources; do not invent achievements
photography: Prefer real school, Hall, sports, and alumni moments over stock imagery
Keep faces clear; avoid cluttered screenshots as hero images
Progress photos should show place/context, not only close-up materials

rules: Always include master brand tags on official posts
Add category + campaign tags automatically from the Hub
Limit extra custom tags to 2–4 relevant tags

approval: Contributors submit; Digital Comms adapts; Approver publishes
Sensitive topics (money disputes, discipline, politics, legal) must escalate
Sponsor logos only with written partnership approval
campaign_themes: Campaigns may use a controlled accent theme (e.g. Main Hall) but must keep navy/crimson/gold family and BCOBA naming visible.
